description: Extract data a snapshot folds (table/list/region), a captured JSON feed by its net<id> handle, or a collection. mode:'crawl' = same-domain link manifest; mode:'media' = verified page-media manifest (optional save:true). >6KB spills to a file.

mode.description: crawl: link manifest (maxDepth/maxWidth/maxPages); media: page-media manifest (save:true downloads)

target.description: ref, name, or css=/xpath=; omit for main content

name: reflex_extract
